# REAL CAPTURE - JBD UP16S (Eco-Worthy 48V 100Ah), FC 0x45 "ReadSlaveData" request + 124-byte response (newer firmware layout).
# Source: marionw @ https://diysolarforum.com/threads/eco-worthy-48v-100ah-5120wh-lifepo4-server-rack-battery.92299/post-1447436
# as transcribed in https://gist.github.com/dmitrych5/e2fa4ef16b0b483808e4f4089846d0d0 ("Alternate Pack Status"). CRC 0xC9D3 verifies.
TX 01 45 00 00 00 54 00 00 d4 d3
RX 01 45 00 00 00 54 00 7c 00 10 0c d8 0c d8 0c d8 0c d8 0c d8 0c d9 0c d8 0c d8 0c da 0c d7 0c da 0c d9 0c d9 0c d9 0c d9 0c d8 0c da 0c d7 14 8d 00 00 00 00 0b 23 0b 21 27 10 1c 7e 00 02 00 48 00 64 00 00 00 00 00 03 00 00 42 4a 34 44 31 38 30 30 30 30 00 30 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 03 e8 03 e8 00 04 0b 25 0b 30 04 02 0b 21 0b 21 0b 22 0b 23 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 d3 c9
